segmentation.name: SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex
segmentation.note: use_fa3 disabled -- separate flash_attn_interface package not installed; plain attention used instead, some speed cost, no accuracy difference.

aea.role: secondary cross-dataset generalization check (indoor, different sensor + depth modality)

synthetic.role: unit-test / eval-harness ground truth only, not a benchmark substitute

camera_chest.role: used only for the body-frame rotation-convention cross-validation

sanpo.intrinsics_source: per-session description.json, session_camera_details[i].left_camera_params, selected by model name (not list order -- a prior bug used list index 0 unconditionally, fixed)
sanpo.distortion: none -- SANPO ships already-rectified pinhole intrinsics

aea.undistortion: calibration.rotate_upright_zoom_only + pinhole rectification (projectaria_tools), verified against rendered frames, not just unit tests

camera_calibration.aea_depth_source: semi-dense MPS SLAM point cloud, z-buffer projected into each frame's real pose
camera_calibration.sanpo_depth_source: dense CREStereo depth map shipped per-frame

evaluation_protocol_pointer: See dashboard/data/ablation_results.json for the full A/B/C/D protocol and results.
